name: environment-switcher
title: Environment switcher
description: Switch between Development, Staging and Production. The live one is drawn with a solid mark and the word Live, and asks for confirmation before you move to it.
docs: Pass environments ({ id, name, description, kind, consequence }), value and onValueChange (or defaultValue). kind is development, preview, staging or production, each with its own mark: an open ring, a dashed ring, a half-filled ring, a solid disc. Production is drawn as live on the button and in the list, with an inverted label that says Live, so it never depends on colour. The list is a menu of radio items with a check on the current one. confirmKinds (default: production) lists the kinds that ask first: an alert dialog names where you come from and where you go, says what changes (the environment's consequence, or a general sentence) and starts on Cancel. Cancel and Escape keep the current environment and return focus to the button. Any other kind switches at once. disabled turns the button off; align lines the list up with either edge. labels translates.
